Cannot evaluate risk metrics (drawdown, volatility) without historical returns.
No benchmark comparison prevents determining alpha or relative strength.
Absence of holdings and cash weight details hinders portfolio construction assessment.
Data errors for all benchmark symbols block any external validation.
